_about: Yabanana's hand-written word bank (no AI): similes by adjective, metaphors by concept ([vehicle, extension]), word palettes by theme, and writing sparks. Loaded by web/pages/_words.html. Add freely; keep it original.

cold: as cold as a landlord's handshake
like a phone with no messages

as warm as your name in your mother's mouth

slow as the last dance of the night

brave: brave as a candle in a drafty room

like a seed in a crack in the sidewalk
brave as a voice that cracks and keeps singing
young: like a song on its first play

old: like a record your father kept

like a sweater full of stories
soft: soft as a whisper in a cathedral
like moss on the north side of a stone
as soft as the inside of a peach
like a voice through a closed door

hard: as hard as saying sorry first
like a bass drum in your chest

like the bass at the back of the club

cool: cool as the other side of the pillow

like honey in a jar by the window

as fragile as the first ice on a pond
like a teacup in a moving truck
fragile as a secret in a group chat
beautiful: beautiful like a city seen from the last train
like a cracked bowl mended with gold
as beautiful as a laugh you didn't expect
like the first snow on a quiet street
beautiful as a harmony nobody planned

list: that only blinks when the boats are gone
you water even in the drought
that plays after everyone's gone home
that cooks dinner and burns the house
cut for a door you haven't found yet
that knows your shoreline by heart
that blooms a little more each morning
that takes the bridges with it
the tide already has its eye on
with the bottom rungs sawed off
that only grows in someone else's soil
with a million lit windows for eyes
you know before the first note
that still fits after all these years
on a coast you swore you'd leave
that smells like everyone you love
for a boat that's done with storms
tugging on the string of your sleep
you direct with your eyes closed
with no floor at the top
you're too scared to let go of
stamped with places that don't exist
that burns the skin it loves
where every face is yours and none of them are
that drops you on a rock
where nobody knows your real name
that keeps moving the finish line
you build while you climb it
spinning slow on the turntable of the world
on the neck of the afternoon
the whole street is invited to
too restless to show your face
that shows up before you do
with the key in your own pocket
that makes small things look like monsters
in a window facing the storm
that bites the hand on the leash
with half the pages glued shut
that opens a door you thought was bricked up
to rooms you didn't know you had
that spend differently in every mouth
under the mat of your life
that never tunes together but still plays
that lost its cage key on purpose
full of things you can't throw away

images: a toothbrush still in the cup
your name in my phone, unopened
two coffee mugs, one cold
the half of the bed that stays made
a song I skip in every playlist
a 5 a.m. alarm that I beat
lunch eaten standing up
sneakers with the soles worn thin
a vision board taped over the crack in the wall
counting change for the bus, counting plans for the future
neon bleeding into puddles
a cab with its light still on
music leaking from an open window
steam rising from the street grates
the last bodega with the lights on
popsicle sticks with jokes on them
a fan oscillating like it's saying no
sand in every pocket
fireflies blinking like slow applause
the ice cream truck playing the same three notes
a shell that keeps the sound of home
footprints the tide erases
a boat tied to nothing
salt drying white on your skin
the horizon sewing sea to sky
shoes piled by the door
a pot that's been on the stove since morning
height marks penciled on the doorframe
a radio in the kitchen always tuned to the same station
a porch light left on for whoever's late
a sign held up in the rain
a chain-link fence with a hole cut through
graffiti on the principal's wall
a crowd singing the same three words
a door kicked open to the street
confetti stuck to everybody's shoes
a strobe that freezes every laugh
the bass drop that makes strangers friends
shoes in one hand, sunrise in the other
everybody singing the wrong words together
a tape rewound with a pencil
a bike left on its side in the grass
names carved in a school desk
the arcade's last token
the smell of rain on a summer driveway
a candle that outlasts the storm
the first bird before the sun
a hand on your shoulder in the dark
light under the door
a choir holding the last note
a fox crossing the road at dusk
moss slowly swallowing a stone wall
an orchard holding its breath before frost
a river talking to itself
wind combing through tall grass
a crowd chanting a name that isn't yours
flashbulbs like a lightning storm
a dressing room with no windows
a smile that's been practiced in the mirror
your face on a billboard in a city you've never seen
